_comment: The guided-install contract of the PIM Manager (GUIDED-INSTALL 4.1-4.6). Invardia's wizard asks exactly these questions and writes the answers to config.json for tools/setup/Install-PimManager.ps1, which validates them again (Test-PimInstallConfig). 'maps' = what the answer drives. Kept in step with Install-PimManager by tests/Test-PimGuidedInstall.ps1.

exitCodes.1: a step failed -- fix it and -Resume
exitCodes.3: bad answers or a bad licence -- nothing was changed

parameters.help: The Microsoft Entra tenant PIM manages. The licence is bound to it.
The Azure subscription that hosts PIM (Container Apps, Azure SQL).
Some subscriptions cannot create new Azure SQL servers in West Europe -- the installer checks the region first.
Created when it does not exist; an existing one is reused.
Set from the licence in the bundle, not asked.
The guided install builds the external shape: the PIM Manager is reachable on the internet behind Microsoft Entra sign-in. A private-network install is a consultant-led setup.
A /23 or larger (Azure Container Apps), inside the VNet range.
Managing and managed tenants (MSP) are set up with support, not by the guided install.
Who may sign in to the PIM Manager. Default: the super-admins.
Every member account of the tenant may sign in (guests never).
Default: you (the account running the install).
The mailbox PIM sends from. Needs an Exchange Administrator; without one the install completes and mail is set up later.
The Invardia Support app of this tenant (pre-filled from the support environment). Empty = no support access.
troubleshoot = read the database and its schema; setup = also repair and upgrade (SQL admin group member, owner of PIM's own apps and groups).

steps.title: Azure SQL in the chosen region

requiredRights: Owner, or Contributor + User Access Administrator, on the subscription (required -- the preflight stops without it)
Privileged Role Administrator, active (recommended) -- without it the SQL admin group, the Graph permissions and the sign-in consent end as hand-off actions with the exact command
Exchange Administrator for the notification mailbox (optional, later)
runsIn: Azure Cloud Shell (PowerShell 7) as the signed-in account -- never a secret. Also PowerShell 7 or Windows PowerShell 5.1 on Windows with the Azure CLI.
licence: A Pro licence bound to the tenant above (a trial or a paid licence). A licence for another tenant, or one that names no tenant, is refused (exit 3).
costStatement: About 27 USD a month (Azure Container Apps scale to zero, Basic registry, Azure SQL serverless-sized, external).
